evidence_mode: Unity batch builder plus real standalone Windows x64 Player visual checks

historical_context.before: D19-R02-S02 and D19-S02-R01 remained PARTIAL; earlier Player evidence showed legacy proxy renderers, flat ground, large labels and blocky silhouettes.
historical_context.after: R03 presentation prefab is instantiated in InitialHarbor and legacy presentation renderers are disabled while stable colliders/anchors are retained. RERUN13 persists generated mesh assets into the prefab, so real Player now shows facades, roofs, market entry, stalls, dock planks and props; the visual gate remains open because fixed cameras, weather and route evidence are still missing.

builds.mesh_persistence_note: Generated meshes are stored as task-owned .asset files under Assets/Art/Materials/D19/R03/Meshes and referenced by the prefab; no runtime-only temporary meshes remain for the R03 generated geometry.

editor_audit_facts.legacy_root_renderer_state: D19_SaintMargaret_Root renderers=957, enabled=0; colliders and stable nodes preserved

real_player_evidence.visual_observation: RERUN14 is a real Windows Player capture after installing a separate D19_R03_ShipVisual prefab under the stable ph_ship_fishing node. The Player shows persistent R03 facades, roofs, market entry, stalls and dock/ship presentation without a pink material or large white proxy plane. The capture also exposes close camera/roof overlap and rough local composition; this does not prove 14 fixed Player cameras, three weather variants, or final visual acceptance.

blocking_reasons: 视觉层仍未达到‘真实港口样板’的最终质量：局部平坦地表、近景屋顶重叠和低细节远景仍可见。
